newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 9.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 9.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Monday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The new police department head sets out the obligations for his deputies. .
- Energy projects are to be financed by state and private enterprises, the energy council with the ministry of economics said.
